summary: Hang is an AI-native loyalty and guest-engagement platform for restaurants, using gamification (spin-the-wheel promos, mystery boxes, quests) and omnichannel data (online orders, in-store visits, delivery apps, social engagement) rather than a traditional points-based loyalty program.

Hang launched a loyalty program for Roam Artisan Burgers, described by Hang as a "next-generation" loyalty rollout, and separately powered a new loyalty program for Island Fin Poké Co. in 2026 that added challenges and interactive gameplay elements. (Scope note: Published on Hang's own Medium blog; exact rollout dates not independently confirmed.)

Hang integrates directly with Square, letting customers enroll with just a phone number and redeem rewards at the POS; Hang's own marketing claims over 8x ROI and a 60%+ average increase in customer spend for participating restaurants. (Scope note: ROI and spend-lift figures are Hang's own self-reported marketing claims, not independently audited.)
